question: What goes wrong when a Flutter ListView uses index-based keys and the list is reordered or filtered?
questionBn: ListView-এ ইনডেক্স-ভিত্তিক key থাকলে লিস্ট রিঅর্ডার/ফিল্টারে কী সমস্যা হয়?
shortAnswer: Elements/State attach to the wrong items—lost text, wrong checkboxes, glitchy animations. Use ValueKey(stableId).
strongAnswer: Keys tell the framework which Element to reuse when the widget configuration updates. Index keys make position identity; after reorder, State follows the slot not the item. Prefer ValueKey or ObjectKey tied to a stable business id.
advancedAnswer: Contrast LocalKey vs GlobalKey costs; discuss UniqueKey anti-pattern that forces remount every build.
followUps: How do keys interact with AnimatedList?
commonWrongAnswer: Keys are only for performance and never affect correctness.
productionRelevance: Todo/cart/chat lists mis-associate draft text with the wrong row after sort/filter—high visibility bugs.
integrationProcedure: 1) Reproduce the scenario in a small spike using Flutter. 2) Write the strong answer as an ADR or PR description. 3) Add a test or monitor that would catch the common wrong answer in production. 4) Document rollback/owner. 5) Rehearse the follow-ups aloud once.
